findings.note: CBS/RotoWire lists Edgecombe at 12.5 PPG, below the 13.5 line. It calls him likely the fifth option and says his scoring swings with whether James, Embiid, Brown and Maxey play; he missed a game in late October with an abdominal bruise before being cleared.

NBA.com's Nov 7 fantasy note says he scored 19 points with a season-high four steals and no turnovers in the Nov 6 loss at Cleveland. This game at Chicago tips at 3:30 pm ET, and the page also notes frontcourt absences (Bona, Barlow).

The preview for the Nov 2 meeting said Chicago was allowing a league-worst 129.3 points per game. Edgecombe then scored 21 on 9-of-12 shooting in 33 minutes in that 126-107 Philly win, though he shot unusually well that night.
